decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (6APFS093/A/P001-P3, 6APFS093/A/P002-P3, 6APFS093/A/P003-P5, 6APFS093/A/P004-P2, 6APFS093/A/P005-P2, 6APFS093/A/P006-P1, Planning Statement (1st April 2015), Extended Phase 1 Habitat Survey (March 2015), Design and Access Statement (April 2015 Rev 0) Received 14/04/2015; Transport Statement (6APFS093) May 2015, Travel Plan Floreat Brentford Primary School Received 22/05/2015; Cycle & Scooter stand details by Portakabin Exteriors (16.12.14 v3) Received 16/02/2015) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The buildings hereby approved shall be removed and the land restored in accordance with a landscaping strategy submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to occupation of any part of the development. Any planting approved as part of the landscaping strategy shall have been completed within the first planting season following removal of the buildings.

Condition : 4 - The buildings hereby approved shall be used for education and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class D1 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 2006, or any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 9:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9:00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - The buildings shall not be occupied until a delivery and servicing plan has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. All deliveries and servicing of the site shall thereafter be managed in compliance with the approved Delivery & Servicing Plan.

Condition : 8 - The buildings shall not be occupied until a detailed Travel Plan, which includes proactive targets, measures and an action plan to reduce car travel and manage traffic impacts, has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved travel plan shall be implemented and monitored throughout the lifetime of the approved development.

Condition : 9 - The buildings hereby approved shall not be occupied until the boundary treatment, consisting of a 2150mm high green chain-link fence, has been completed in accordance with the detailed contained in the application and plans.

Condition : 10 - The cycle stands (min. 20 spaces) and kick-scooter stands (min. 40 spaces) shall be available for use before first occupation of the hereby approved buildings and maintained as such thereafter in accordance with the details contained in the application and plans.

Condition : 11 - Prior to commencement of the hereby approved development, the developer shall procure the necessary highway works associated with the addition of waiting restrictions (including School Keep Clear markings and other waiting and loading restrictions) on Half Moon Close. The developer shall demonstrate, in writing, that arrangements have been put in place to carry out the proposed works (which will involve the agreement of the local highway authority and/or adjoining landowners). Such measures shall be completed prior to occupation of any part of the development. All parking restrictions on Half Moon Close shall be removed at the cessation of there hereby approved development in accordance with Condition 3 of this consent.

Condition : 12 - A) No development shall take place until the applicant (or their heirs and successors in title) has secured the implementation of a programme of archaeological evaluation in accordance with a written scheme which has been submitted by the applicant and approved by the local planning authority in writing and a report on that evaluation has been submitted to the local planning authority.
B) If heritage assets of archaeological interest are identified by the evaluation under Part A, then before development commences the applicant (or their heirs and successors in title) shall secure the implementation of a programme of archaeological investigation in accordance with a Written Scheme of Investigation which has been submitted by the applicant and approved by the local planning authority in writing.
C) No development shall take place other that in accordance with the Written Scheme of Investigation approved under Part (B).
D) The development shall not be occupied until the site investigation and post investigation assessment has been completed in accordance with the programme set out in the Written Scheme of Investigation approved under Part (B), and the provision for analysis, publication and dissemination of the results and archive deposition has been secured.

Condition : 13 - Prior to commencement of the hereby approved development, detailed drainage designs which cover all outstanding information referred to as being included in such future detailed designs in the Assessment of Surface Water Planning form submitted to the Council on 2nd June 2015, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Such designs shall include the achievement of the Non-Statutory Technical Standards for SuDS and align to the related London Plan policies wherever necessary.

Condition : 14 - (A) No development shall take place until the details of a Sustainable Urban Drainage scheme (SUDs), including measures for (i) the harvesting of rainwater, (ii) the minimisation of water run-off from the site, aiming for greenfield levels, achieving at least a 50% improvement on existing levels, and (iii) the conservation and reuse as appropriate of other water supplies in the buildings have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.
 
(B) The building(s) shall not be occupied until evidence has (e.g. photographs and copies of installation contracts) have been submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to demonstrate that the development has been carried out in accordance with the approved details and the drainage system is working efficiently.
description: Erection of two temporary school buildings together with provision of children's covered play area.
